name: Clips for fixing twisted bag strap! (OpenSCAD)

captions.detailed: This 3D model consists of a two-part clamp or clip system designed to wrap around a strap. Each half is a flat, rectangular plate with rounded, cylindrical hook-like edges at both ends, which act as hinges or clamp grips. One of the halves features a central latching tab on its sides, while the other half has corresponding cutouts to receive these tabs, allowing them to snap-fit together securely.
captions.instruction: Design a parametric strap clip in OpenSCAD that consists of two mating halves. The script should use parameters for the length, width, and thickness of the clip, and feature snap-fit tabs on one half with matching interlocking cutouts on the other half, using cylindrical hinges at both ends.
captions.factory: The script uses variables x, y, and z to control the dimensions. Each of the two halves is constructed using a base cube combined with rotated cylinders at the ends to form the rounded hinges. Boolean operations (difference) subtract smaller concentric cylinders to create hollow pivot points, and a bottom-half cube is subtracted to leave only the top-facing shell. The interlocking tabs and slots are created using intersections of angled cubes rotated by 70 degrees and -70 degrees, combined with standard cubes.
